summary: Frontend-only validation of MedFlow after fixes: (1) blank landing page and (2) new dashboard logo. Both fixes are verified working end-to-end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing at https://iniciar-launch.preview.emergentagent.com/ renders fully (title 'MedFlow — Uma decisão por vez', header MedFlow, Entrar button, and features section including 'Aprenda com um Preceptor IA'). No spinner stuck, zero calls to old b79f9c3a domain, zero HTTP >=400 responses, zero network failures. Admin login (/admin-login) POST /api/auth/admin-login returns 200 and redirects to /admin which renders the Shell layout. data-testid='sidebar-logo' contains
rca of the issue: Blank landing was caused by REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL pointing to an old domain (b79f9c3a) that returned 502, so /api/auth/status hung and the app remained in loading state. Fix: updated frontend/.env to https://iniciar-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. Logo change: Shell.jsx now references /brand/medflow-icon.png which exists in public and serves 200.
